name: auto-model
description: Picks the model and thinking effort for each turn from how hard your prompt looks: easy prompts go to a fast model, hard ones to a stronger model that thinks longer.

judge.title: How difficulty is judged
judge.description: heuristic: local rules, instant and free. model: a quick call to the easy-tier model reads the prompt first (adds about a second and a small cost), falling back to the rules if it fails.

easyModel.title: Easy prompts: model
easyModel.description: Model alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id, for easy prompts.

mediumModel.title: Medium prompts: model
mediumModel.description: Model alias or full id for medium prompts.

hardModel.title: Hard prompts: model
hardModel.description: Model alias or full id for hard prompts.

expertModel.title: Expert prompts: model
expertModel.description: Model alias or full id for the very hardest prompts.

expertEffort.title: Expert prompts: thinking effort
expertEffort.description: Thinking effort for the very hardest prompts.
